title: Buyer Beware
text: Buyer Beware. I don't get it.  I ordered this exact frame with a white mat 2 weeks ago, and it was lovely.  I had looked for one with real glass - and the one I got previously was just as ordered.  The one I just got today was 16x20 with an opening for an 11x14 picture (not 11x14 with opening for 8x10 as ordered); with a black mat (not white as ordered); with a cheap, flimsy and scratched piece of plexiglass (not even close to real glass).  I don't know if the company or amazon messed up, but I will not order again.
